headline: Google reports a Gemini 4 Argon workflow porting an ocean model from Fortran to Rust
summary: Google Antigravity reports that Gemini 4 Argon migrated the 174,774-line Fortran/C core of FVCOM to safe Rust in a 59-minute run, with 100-seed numerical parity, 42 tests, 96.8% branch coverage, six reported bug findings and 1.88× runtime after optimization. The post gives stage timings and a runtime/memory scorecard, making the account more detailed than a product demo. The run, metrics, exact input correspondence and scientific validity remain first-party and have not been independently reproduced; the linked skill’s immutable source and run artifacts were unavailable in this review.
